name: Enhanced Brain Guzzler (Central Research)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-10: Once in Whispers

defensiveAbilities.name: Repair Nanites (Fast Healing 7)
defensiveAbilities.description: The brain guzzler has integrated nanites that swarm over damage, healing it.

defensiveAbilities.name: Cybernetics
defensiveAbilities.description: The cybernetics of a brain guzzler can be disabled for 1 hour with a successful Disable device dc=22 check. A brain guzzler's cybernetics are disabled for 1 hour if it takes any electricity damage. A brain guzzler with disabled cybernetics is Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

defensiveAbilities.name: Guzzle
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The brain guzzler kills an enemy

Effect The brain guzzler breaks open its victim's skull and eats the brain. The brain guzzler gains knowledge of the victim's memories, and its Intelligence increases by +1. The victim can no longer be raised from the dead by any method that requires an intact corpse and rises as a zombie shambler the next day at dawn.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ulna Bow
offensiveAbilities.description: The brain guzzler fires with the ulna bow, which rips the ulna out of its own forearm and fires it at one target within 120 feet. The target must succeed at a Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save or take (3d8+5) Piercing Damage damage. The ulna explodes on impact, dealing 4d8 Piercing Damage damage to adjacent creatures (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save). Once the ulna bow has been used once it can't be used again.
